relatedLinks.label: #327: express range sums as prefix differences
relatedLinks.explanation: 02Why is a range sum a difference of two totals?Can we get a range sum without adding its elements again? Prefix P[k] is the total of the first k elements; P[0]=0 means taking none. Here j is an exclusive end. The original inclusive interval [i,j−1] sums to P[j]−P[i]: subtract the first i elements, leaving i through j−1.Keep the array fixed and select i<j. Compare the two P values with the remaining elements below. In these formulas, j is always a prefix index.Select prefix indices (i,j)i=0, j=1i=0, j=2i=0, j=3i=1, j=2i=1, j=3i=2, j=3Prefix index k and total P[k]P[0]=0P[1]=-2P[2]=3P[3]=2P[1] − P[0] = -2 − (0) = -2; original interval [0,0] = [-2]: Count.We now count prefix-index pairs with i<j and lower ≤ P[j]−P[i] ≤ upper. P[0] lets ranges starting at index 0 use the same formula. Prefix differences make one sum O(1), but enumerating all index pairs is still O(n²).

#327：用前缀差表示区间和
relatedLinks.explanation: 02一段的和为什么是两个总数之差？这一步要回答：能不能不用重加一段元素？前缀 P[k] 是前 k 个元素的总和；P[0]=0 表示一个也没取。这里 j 是不包含的右边界，原题的闭区间 [i,j−1] 的和就是 P[j]−P[i]：减去前 i 个，剩下 i 到 j−1。保持数组不变，选择一对 i<j；比较两个 P 值与下方留下的元素。所有公式中的 j 都是前缀下标。选择前缀下标 (i,j)i=0, j=1i=0, j=2i=0, j=3i=1, j=2i=1, j=3i=2, j=3前缀下标 k 与总和 P[k]P[0]=0P[1]=-2P[2]=3P[3]=2P[1] − P[0] = -2 − (0) = -2；原区间 [0,0] = [-2]：计入。因此目标变成：数出 i<j 且 lower ≤ P[j]−P[i] ≤ upper 的前缀下标对。P[0] 让从下标 0 开始的区间也能用同一式子。前缀差只把每次求和降到 O(1)，枚举所有下标对仍是 O(n²)。
